title: SmtpRelayError missing #[non_exhaustive]: adding variant is a breaking change
description: SmtpRelayError is a public enum without #[non_exhaustive]. Any downstream code that matches on it exhaustively will break when a new variant is added. Since is_transient()/is_permanent() provide classification, callers do use exhaustive matches in tests. Adding #[non_exhaustive] now is free; forgetting it means a semver bump for every variant addition.
